Subject: Request: supplemental credits & demo-day sweetener

Hi Irene,

Hope you’re well — LaunchForge is in the home stretch for our cohort demo day (Oct 15). Several companies in the cohort hit usage spikes in the last week and asked if we can top up their Redwood credits so their demos don't get throttled.

Quick background: cohort of 12 teams, three teams have unusually high inference during final testing. We already consumed most of the free pilot credits that were allocated in June. The ask: can Redwood grant a small, one-time supplemental credit pool (recommended 50k tokens across the three teams) and lock a promotional committed discount if any of them convert to paid Dedicated within 90 days?

What matters most to us: 1) speed (we need approval this week), 2) simple T&Cs (no long procurement), and 3) a defined convert clause (credit applies to intro invoice).

Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks — Anna

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: supplemental credits & demo-day sweetener

Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for flagging — +1 to approving a limited, time-boxed sweetener. Suggested approach (ops-friendly and low-risk):

1) One-time supplemental pool: 50,000 tokens total, split across the three teams. Grant as promotional "credit bucket" allocated to LaunchForge-managed sub-accounts. Credits expire in 30 days (to match demo day horizon).

2) Convert incentive: If any team signs a Redwood Dedicated contract and activates within 90 days, Redwood will apply a credit equal to 20% of the supplemental tokens (token value calculated at the promotional per-token rate) to the first invoice, applied as a dollar credit, capped at $2,500 per converting team.

3) Operationalization: We will issue a one-page SOW (term sheet) outlining the above and require an email acknowledgment from LaunchForge. No full procurement. Legal ops can pre-clear the SOW template.

I attached a quick draft SOW and a pricing grid for Q4. Please review — if approved, I can send to Anna with a one-line acceptance path.

Ben Carter
Director, Growth Partnerships | Redwood Inference
